notes.title: Music Encore! New songs, new controls, new sticker!
notes.content:
Did you know that every song in Kind Words 2 has four moods? As you move from home to city, to café to mountain top, each song changes with the feel of the location. Drums morph, timbres shift, vibes slide. 

Did you notice that even the menu sound effects change pitch to match the key of the current song? Who does that?!

Clark Aboud does that!

And now he's made [i]4 new songs![/i]

[list]
[*] Golden Dreamer
[*] Cloud Watching
[*] Cerulean
[*] Ampersand
[/list]

And song each has four moods. Moods and tracks that you can now flip through with the new [b]"Music Control Panel with Frog Head"[/b] (patent pending). They're going in to the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254860/Kind_Words_2_Soundtrack/] soundtrack DLC[/url] too, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/f65da0bebc5679aa3dd0ceef721f121b2aa65e18.jpg[/img]

He even wrote a little ditty that the train plays when it pulls in to the station.

And so we honor Clark in the most Kind Wordsiest of fashions… with the [b]new Clark sticker[/b]. 

We hope the new music and moods helps with your mood today.

Cheers,
Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/47a473660e70f3d5e011a706f87908ca275ccf69.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/a08a863aff27ae5da488d1a047cbb0044e892edd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Private journal. Shared inspiration.
notes.content:
Kind Words 2 is great for sharing your thoughts with caring strangers, but sometimes you just need to talk to yourself. 
	
Now Kind Words 2 has a private journal. A journal is a great way put your day or your life in to perspective. Forming your stresses in to words can calm you down. And good days with good feelings deserve to be commemorated. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/6d5cb9ad623b793e8507428b39e5ae9839babbac.gif[/img]
	
This part of Kind Words 2 is for your eyes only. We don't store it on our servers. The optional steam cloud storage is encrypted before uploading. 
	
If you need a little inspiration to write, we've added a spot where you can browse and share writing prompts to get you going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/d969bc9513c29a08d5bdd5f223abe6f0390fb60d.gif[/img]
	
Kind Words 2 invites you to bring your whole, complex, beautiful, messy self. And now there's a place for the parts that are too detailed or too personal to share with others.

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/47a473660e70f3d5e011a706f87908ca275ccf69.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/a08a863aff27ae5da488d1a047cbb0044e892edd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: More stickers? Yes, please.
notes.content:
Shakespeare died in 1616. But before he did, he wrote several plays that people enjoyed. However, he did not leave behind very many cute stickers. I won't lie: it impressed me a little bit that he could just give up like that. Like he didn't really care about his legacy. Respect. 

We're not that strong. We need your approval. We've added a bunch of adorable new stickers to Kind Words 2. Enjoy!

notes.title: The soundtrack DLC is here!
notes.content:
I'm delighted to let you know the soundtrack to Kind Words 2 is now available for purchase as DLC on Steam! 

To celebrate, I've created a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46270/Kind_Wordses__Soundtracks/]new Steam bundle [/url]that includes both Kind Words games and both Kind Words soundtracks at a discount.

I'm so grateful to Clark Aboud for sharing his talents as composer on Kind Words and Kind Words 2 and I've invited him to tell you a bit about his work in his own words:

[h1]A Letter from Clark[/h1]

The first Kind Words soundtrack was a beautiful and appreciated (thank you Ziba & Luigi) opportunity to just write music freely (fitting, for a game about writing freely), so getting the chance to step back into that comfortable isometric room and out into the big new city has been an exciting one.

The subtitle of lofi city pop was a ticket to a wonderful world of music that I will ever be an admirer and student of, with its dense harmonies, bright grooves, and toppest of top tier bass lines. Bringing touches of those inspirations into the lofi sampling, synths, and style of the original, led to recording guitars, drums, strings, harp, brass, piano, and more, re-sequencing on samplers, printing to recycled cassette tapes, running through guitar pedals, and once again enjoying writing freely.

All of these new spaces to visit gave room for rearrangements and remixes of each of the songs, written to suit the different atmospheres of each corner of the city. Some of my favourite rearrangements are the Ambient remixes that can be heard on Snow Mountain, at Last Stop and in the Chain Forest. (You’ll find these on the soundtrack along with the original songs).

Just like the first, I feel incredibly privileged to be a part of this game, and now a part of your time in the new city as you write, talk, and share.

Clark.

notes.title: Faster, more reliable (?) scene transitions
notes.content:
Today's challenge has been tracking down the cause of the reports I'm getting that sometimes the game gets stuck when transitioning between spaces.

The tricky part is that it never happens to me! 

So today I rewrote a good deal of the code that handles transitioning between scenes. If it's not more reliable, it is at least more careful and will hopefully leave much better clues as to the source of the problem.

A nice side bonus is that it's much faster to wander through the chain forest now.

Thanks for playing and for the patience of those affected by the transitioning bug.

Cheers,
Ziba

notes.title: Thank you for an amazing launch!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for making the launch of Kind Words 2 wonderful! 

For years Luigi and I have been wandering around this city by ourselves. Like kids who snuck in to an amusement park when none of the rides are running. We've spent so long walking through while imagining what it would be like full of people. 

What will be most popular? How busy will it feel?  What ride will go off the rails? 

We had a few brilliant glimpses of the future during our playtesting, but this Monday when the doors opened, Kind Words 2 truly began not just for our players, but for us developers as well. 

[i]Everything feels so alive now! [/i]

Since Monday, players have started [b]over 11,000 conversations[/b] with each other! We had a feeling chatting would be popular. More surprising is the [b]10,000 messages you've written in the chain forest[/b]! 
In less than 5 days! 

Judging by the sheer volume of nice messages floating about, things appear to be running mostly smoothly. But we have also had excellent feedback about bugs and quality improvements that I am now hard at work on. I'm very grateful for your communications and suggestions. Please keep them coming in game, in [url=https://discord.gg/popcannibal]discord[/url] and on Steam! 

And once you feel we've earned it, please consider leaving a review. 

Wrapping up, if I may briefly switch metaphors from Kind Words 2 being an amusement park to being my child, I'd like to embarrass it here with a baby photo from 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/dddab75ccfe4c714be326e1d1b8ee89bafe52863.jpg[/img]

We've come a long way. Thank you so much for being here with us now!

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Kind Words 2 is Here!
notes.content:
[h1]But what [i]is[/i] Kind Words 2?[/h1]

[h2]It's a game about being nice to people![/h2]

All real people. Anonymous and asynchronous. Share your worries, joys, dreams, wishes, jokes and more.  Then read everybody else's messages and respond where you feel comfortable doing so. We've made a little city full of different activities for you to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/14dcb8544ef2a087148b0a9c51b372166a2374af.gif[/img]

[h2]It's a social network![/h2]

But it's kind of an anti-social network. We wanted to create a place where you can interact with real people and never have to worry about whether you're fitting in or winning. There's no numbers to tell you how many people liked something. There's no identities to worry about keeping consistent.  Give and receive the gift of just being yourself with people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/ab30dd022707fabcdcc87222c24578bdd411afc9.gif[/img]


[h2]It's a better version of the original Kind Words[/h2]

It includes a full, backwards compatible remaster of Kind Words. If you didn't play the original, you won't miss out! The models and textures have been re-created with the wisdom granted by time. The UI is much more attractive AND accessible. Now there's keyboard and gamepad controls. Also, the whole thing works offline!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/039855bb95a87116fd3ce630af70efb68dc3d4d4.gif[/img]


[h2]It's a much bigger game than Kind Words[/h2]

Kind Words has a laser focus on you, stuck in your bedroom with worries and well wishes. 

But Kind Words 2 lets you run outside that room and explore a city full of new activities! People brought so much of themselves to Kind Words that we couldn't embrace it all gracefully. Now there's so many more places for you to be you. Change your look, chat, joke, philosophize, dream, rhyme, vent, name cats. NAME CATS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/a83ae7d61e116bcc69a0f7a69c45c31079f64c5c.gif[/img]

[h2]Its a labor of love by a tiny team![/h2]

I'm Ziba. I write the code and posts like this. Luigi does ALL the art. Clark writes the music (and his musician friends play it). That's it!

We've spent the last 5 years caring for the shockingly kind community that formed around Kind Words. And now we're almost unbearably excited to open the doors to this greatly expanded experience. We made if for you and we hope you like it.

Now please go tell your friends, neighbors, enemies, lovers, strangers and strange lovers that Kind Words 2 is here!

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Thank You! The playtest/demo was awesome! But now it's over.
notes.content:
Thank you! 

You all did so much for Kind Words! The playtest and the demo are over. We are definitely sad to kick everybody out of Kind Words 2 for a bit. But the life you all breathed in to it is just what we needed to guide our final development push.  

For [i]years[/i] we've been working on these features with only our imaginations filling in how they would actually be used. We now we have heaps of real player messages of all kinds. It's time for us to digest it and make sure we're making the most of all your kind and creative energies. 

Here's some amazing numbers generated by you 6,000+ playtesters: 

[list]
[*] 3,951 cat names! 
[*] 7,393 in-game feedback submissions! 
[*] 18,740 conversations! 
[*] 22,611 chain forest entries! 
[/list]
(Also, 600 new [url=discord.gg/popcannibal]discord[/url] members!)

I could say a lot more, but now we have to dive in and tweak and tune to get ready to have you all back... this fall. 

Yours, 

Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Open Playtest Starts Today!
notes.content:
Play Kind Words 2 for free right now! We are opening up playtesting to everyone by putting out a demo for 1 week only starting now.

Kind Words 2 is almost done and we're joining the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration by inviting you to try it out and give us the feedback we need to cross the finish line in style.

Download the demo and explore a whole city of online conversations with real people. Share your feelings, wishes, poems, jokes, dreams, everything that makes you you.

This playtest includes a full remaster of the original Kind Words. Plus a new room with new stickers. If you played before, your letters will be waiting for you. If you haven't, well then this is like getting to play two new games for free!

We're looking forward to spending time with you.

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: New Stickers Teaser
notes.content:
Luigi sent me 22 new stickers to put in to Kind Words 2 this week. They're really cute and I think you're gonna like them. I hate to do this to you, but I'm not going to show any of them right now. Nope. 

Just gonna tease you with some outlines. I'm going to selfishly dangle them out there to evoke curiosity which will blossom into longing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779608/ce8e474d9f8d83d64cbfd347a31e159b69ee4d74.png[/img]

That longing will inspire action. Action like wishlisting Kind Words 2 and telling all your friends to do the same. It's a cruel play on your emotions, especially for a game so deeply rooted in principles of caring and generosity.

But also, aren't the rhythms of anticipation and reward the foundation of that which makes life exciting? Isn't it the sweet contrast created by desiring and receiving that make you feel like you're doing more than just existing? Don't our dreams of what life [i]could be[/i] carry us through the limited reality of what life is?

Anyways, new stickers! Get hyped.

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Coffee Talk meets Animal Crossing in stunning cozy Steam game
notes.content:
Let's face it: interacting with gamers on the internet can oftentimes be a cesspool of angst and conflict, but thankfully, series like Kind Words are tipping the scale. Debuted in 2019 to cult fanfare, Kind Words encouraged gamers to write nice letters to real players while trading stickers and listening to chill lofi tunes. It's certainly a niche game with limited appeal, but its recently announced sequel will be expanding on this chill letter-writing loop if this is your cup of tea.

Read the rest of the story...
